summary: NexPoint Capital, Inc., a non-traded Delaware business development company, filed a routine Item 8.01 Form 8-K disclosing that its net asset value per share and distribution reinvestment plan issuance price were set at $4.68 per share as of August 31, 2026, determined under Rule 2a-5 valuation policies approved by the Board and administered by the Adviser. No securities offering, transaction, or corporate action beyond the periodic NAV/DRP pricing update is described. The filing includes standard forward-looking statement language and is signed by Frank Waterhouse, Principal Financial Officer, Treasurer. No deal terms, advisor, premium, or closing conditions apply; this is ordinary periodic disclosure, not a special situation.
